bio: I am an undergraduate student at Sun Yat-sen University, majoring in Intelligent Science and Technology. My research focuses on video generation, world models, and multimodal spatiotemporal understanding.
我是中山大学智能科学与技术专业本科生，研究兴趣主要集中在视频生成、世界模型与多模态时空理解。

My research began with graph learning and has grown toward video and 4D scenes. I am particularly interested in how models represent objects, maintain their states over time, and use generation to understand and interact with the world.
我的研究从图学习出发，逐渐延伸到视频与 4D 场景。我关注模型如何表示对象、持续维护对象状态，以及如何通过生成来理解世界并与之交互。

I collaborate with researchers at HKUST, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Westlake University on video generation and world-action modeling. I am also part of InkMind.AI, where we explore multimodal understanding and generation, along with tools and workflows for AI-assisted research.
目前，我与香港科技大学、上海交通大学和西湖大学的研究者合作，开展视频生成与世界-动作模型研究。我也是 InkMind.AI 的一员，与伙伴们共同探索多模态理解与生成，以及 AI 辅助科研工具与工作流。
news: We release LaST, preserving object geometry and appearance across occlusion and reappearance in long-video generation.
我们发布了 LaST，在长视频生成中保持对象遮挡或离开视野后重现时的几何与外观一致性。
We release TRACE for conversational humanoid motion editing with typed references.
我们发布了 TRACE，通过类型化参照实现对话式人形动作编辑。
We release EviGDA, exploring complementary evidence beyond representation learning for graph domain adaptation.
我们发布了 EviGDA，通过互补证据融合，将图领域适应延伸到表示学习之外。
We release AstraDraw for editable research figures with GPT-6 Astra—nearly 150 GitHub stars 🎉🎉!
我们发布了 AstraDraw，面向 GPT-6 Astra 的可编辑科研绘图工作流，已收获近 150 GitHub stars 🎉🎉！
We release POSReasoner for persistent object-state reasoning in video instance segmentation.
我们发布了 POSReasoner，通过持久对象状态推理改善视频实例分割中的身份保持。
We release DRCIM-ML for robust competitive influence maximization in multilayer networks.
我们发布了 DRCIM-ML，研究多层网络中的鲁棒竞争影响力最大化。
We release LMM-Track4D for 4D dynamic reasoning through trajectory-grounded dialogue.
我们发布了 LMM-Track4D，通过轨迹对话实现 4D 动态推理。
Our work on critical-node identification receives the GBCESC 2025 Best Paper Award.
我们的关键节点识别研究获得 GBCESC 2025 最佳论文奖。
